purpose: Source provenance and parameter boundaries for a literature-informed corrugated-board finite-element example. This is not a same-lot reconstruction or crease validation record.
recipe_status: mixed-source literature proxy used as a preformed stress-free starting board; not a same-roll reconstruction or complete source-exact manufactured-board model

sources.citation: Haj-Ali, R., Choi, J., Wei, B.-S., Popil, R., and Schaepe, M. (2009). Refined nonlinear finite element models for corrugated fiberboards. Composite Structures 87(4), 321-333.
evidence_locations: Printed p.323, section 2: constituent names, basis weights, and tensile testing.
Printed p.324, Table 1 and Figs. 1-2: directional tensile yield points and bilinear stress-strain plots.
Printed pp.324-325, Eqs. 1-4 and Tables 2-4: elastic constants, Hill function, yield assumptions, Tsai-Wu limits.
Printed p.326, Table 5 and text: C-flute pitch and height, measured and idealized sinusoid.
Printed pp.331-332, section 5 and Table 8: glue material and finite parametric glue-solid geometries.

hill_model.source_equation: Article Eq. 2, quadratic Hill orthotropic yield function, with F,G,H,L,M,N computed from directional yield stresses using Eq. 3.
hill_model.hardening: Bilinear curves are plotted in Figs. 1-2, but numerical post-yield slopes are not tabulated.
hill_model.compression_assumption: Compression yield stress and strain assumed as 60% of corresponding in-plane tension values. Table 3 supplies the ZD yield values used for Hill; these are based on a cited relation, not direct ZD tests.
hill_model.shear_assumption: Source states tau12=2.1 MPa and tau13=tau23=0.024 MPa; not reported as direct sheet-specific measurements.
hill_model.rounding_note: 60% of Table 1 medium MD tensile stress 15.7 MPa is 9.42 MPa, while Table 3 prints 9.391 MPa, consistent with an underlying more precise tensile value. Retain Table 3 value for source Hill reconstruction and note the discrepancy.

flute.height_definition: Source does not clearly establish whether tabulated height is centerline peak-to-trough or an outer-face envelope dimension. Do not infer the definition.

implemented_recipe_choice.pitch_status: measured specimen pitch reported by source; selected instead of the article's 8.50 mm FE pitch
implemented_recipe_choice.height_status: derived to close the 4.210 mm board caliper using two 0.277 mm liner coupons, one 0.191 mm medium coupon, and glue gaps 0.100 mm and 0.030 mm; not a published height measurement

adhesive_from_explicit_glue_study.material_model: homogeneous isotropic 3-D continuum elastic glue solid in the reported explicit glue study
adhesive_from_explicit_glue_study.fracture_energy_status: not reported; no calibrated cohesive/debonding law
adhesive_from_explicit_glue_study.geometry_status: Source reports parametric rectangular glue solid zones; the implemented curved surface-conforming bridge is an explicit adaptation, not published measured glue geometry.

sources.citation: Popil, R. E., Schaepe, M. K., Haj-Ali, R., Wei, B.-S., and Choi, J. (2007). Adhesive level effect on corrugated board strength – experiment and FE modeling. International Progress in Paper Physics Seminar report, 6 pp.
sources.publication_type: conference/seminar report; source file calls itself an abstract submitted to the seminar
evidence_locations: Printed p.3: FE adhesive modulus and Poisson ratio; apparent slope measurement interval.
Printed pp.5-6: IPST double-backer simulator sequence, bath temperature, doctor gaps, and applied adhesive levels.

sequence: meter adhesive through a doctored gravure-roll applicator
pause over pressure-actuated hotplate for a prescribed but unreported time
simulator_process.mass_level_basis: inferred from produced-board masses and component weights; whether reported as dry-solids mass is unspecified

reported: ECT changes with adhesive type and level; up to 12% increase is stated from 0.1 to 0.4 mm doctor gap
FE ECT load/deflection and out-of-plane buckling responses
not_validated: local cohesive strength or fracture energy
crease moment-angle, residual fold, or springback

sources.citation: Popil, R. E. (2017). The Physical Testing of Paper. First published 2017. Used here at printed pp.61, 108-109, 120-123.
sources.publication_type: technical book; publicly accessible author/publisher work in Georgia Tech repository
evidence_locations: Printed pp.108-109, section 5.5.1: commercial WC 4226C 42 board grade and ECT arrangements/rates.
Printed p.120, Table 5.4: finished-board caliper/basis weight/SCT/Taber/ECT values.
Printed p.123: pilot corrugator and manual Stein-Hall starch double-backing sequence.
Printed p.61, Table 4.1: separate kraft-liner and NSSC-medium soft-caliper samples.

commercial_board_benchmark.caliper_interpretation_status: rotated Table 5.4 header visibly states μm; value converts directly to 4.210 mm
commercial_board_benchmark.ECT_method: TAPPI T 839 clamp arrangement or resin-embedded ends; stated specimen height at or below 60 mm avoids beam-buckling influence for this board under the described support methods

separate_paper_coupon_proxy.status: these are separate Table 4.1 soft-caliper coupons, not identified as constituent rolls of WC 4226C 42 or Haj-Ali's 2009 constitutive sheets; selected in the implementation only as thickness/density proxies

manufacturing_evidence.pilot_single_facer: conventional operating parameters are mentioned without numeric operating conditions
manufacturing_evidence.double_backing: metered rolling-nip application of Stein-Hall starch to flute tips, then hotplate press to attach liner

implemented_starting_recipe.name: literature2009
implemented_starting_recipe.identity: mixed-source literature proxy; Haj-Ali 2009 paper elasticity/yield, Popil 2017 commercial board caliper, separate Popil 2017 Table 4.1 coupon thickness/density, Haj-Ali Table 8 glue geometry, and Popil 2007 dried-starch elastic modulus

coupon.dimension_status: numerical coupon dimensions; not a published physical test coupon

paper_thickness_density_proxy.liner_source: Popil 2017 Table 4.1, 42# brown kraft liner coupon, 277 um soft-platen caliper; separate sample, not known to be the commercial board roll
paper_thickness_density_proxy.medium_source: Popil 2017 Table 4.1, 26# NSSC medium coupon, 191 um soft-platen caliper; separate sample, not known to be the commercial board roll

core_profile.derivation: board caliper minus two liner thicknesses, medium thickness, and the two different glue gaps: 4.210 - 2*0.277 - 0.191 - 0.100 - 0.030 = 3.335 mm
core_profile.status: derived geometric closure for this implementation; not a source-measured flute height

double_back_lower_gap.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 8, Type II double-back zone

single_face_upper_gap.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 8, Type II single-face zone

glue.bridge_shape: curved surface-following geometry adapted from the source rectangular zones
glue.density_status: numerical assumption; no published matching starch density
glue.failure_model: none; perfectly bonded elastic bridges, no cohesive separation or fracture

paper_constitutive_implementation.elasticity: Haj-Ali 2009 orthotropic Table 2 inputs; retain source measured/estimated/assumed labels
paper_constitutive_implementation.yield: compression-calibrated Hill orthotropic yield surface using the source's compression assumptions and inferred out-of-plane/shear values
paper_constitutive_implementation.plasticity: ideal plasticity, zero hardening, associated flow
paper_constitutive_implementation.source_fit_status: not the source's full plotted bilinear elastic-plastic fit; source post-yield slopes are not tabulated
paper_constitutive_implementation.failure: none; Tsai-Wu failure/damage is not implemented

omitted_manufacturing_physics: corrugator thermal, pressure, speed, and moisture history
implemented_starting_recipe.validation_status: physical fold, crease, springback, and box assembly validation have not been demonstrated; published ECT targets are not a claim of a completed match

implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.paper: Use Haj-Ali 2009 E/nu/G and Hill yield inputs as source values with measured-versus-derived/assumed annotations. The paper reports no constituent caliper or density. The current implementation uses compression-calibrated Hill ideal plasticity with H=0, associated flow, and Green-strain kinematics; this is not the full source bilinear fit because post-yield slopes are not tabulated.
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.glue_modulus: 400 MPa from the dried-starch apparent-slope value used by Popil et al. 2007 and repeated in the 2009 explicit glue study.
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.glue_poisson_ratio: 0.3, explicitly assumed by Popil et al. 2007 for homogeneous adhesive FE.
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.glue_density: If a density is required, 1500 kg/m^3 is a solver numerical assumption, not source-derived or starch-calibrated. Record separately and do not use it as validation evidence.
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.glue_geometry: The current recipe selects Table 8 Type II dimensions (double-back lower .800 mm width x .100 mm gap; single-face upper .600 mm width x .030 mm gap), mapped to curved surface-following finite bridges. The curved bridge geometry is an adaptation of the source rectangles.
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.adhesive_failure: No published matching-grade Gc or cohesive law found in these sources. Current finite glue should remain perfectly bonded/elastic unless separately calibrated evidence is supplied.
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.paper_sheet_density_and_thickness: Current starter uses Popil 2017 Table 4.1 separate coupons: liner .277 mm / 766 kg/m^3 and medium .191 mm / 679 kg/m^3. These do not establish same-lot data with the commercial WC 4226C board or Haj-Ali 2009 constitutive sheets.
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.profile: Current starter uses measured 7.9 mm pitch and derives 3.335 mm centerline peak-to-trough height to close the 4.210 mm board caliper. This is not the Haj-Ali FE sinusoid (8.50 mm pitch x 3.50 mm height).
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.manufacturing_conditions: The simulator's 37.8 C adhesive bath and 0.1/0.2/0.4 mm doctor gaps are process observations, not cured adhesive material geometry. Line speed, corrugating-roll heat, hotplate pressure/dwell, moisture and cured thickness are absent.
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.initial_condition: Preformed, conditioned, stress-free geometry; no flute-forming, cure, moisture, or residual-stress simulation.
implementation_inputs_and_assumptions.validation_boundary: Physical folding, crease response, springback, and box assembly have not been validated. Published ECT is a future comparison target, not current validation evidence.

explicit_nonclaims: Not a same-roll or same-lot reproduction across the 2009, 2007, and 2017 sources.
Not a source-exact density or thickness definition for 2009's 205/126 g/m^2 constituent papers.
Not a cohesive or debonding-capable starch adhesive model.
Not an experimentally validated rotary crease, fold, residual-set, or springback model.
Not a claim that the conforming finite bridge shape appears in the publications.
retained_sources_policy: PDF copies are retained outside the repository for audit only; the PDFs are not redistributed in this source package.
